# Test dependencies for GitHub Actions on Fedora.
#
# Host image-generation toolchain. rd-make.exe is built with the host
# compiler.
make
gcc
binutils

# QEMU and raw-disk image generation. util-linux provides sfdisk, losetup,
# mount and umount.
qemu-system-x86
util-linux
dosfstools
e2fsprogs

# Test harness.
tmux
socat

# Python environment used by the lit runners.
python3
python3-pip

# Debug and pre-commit tools.
gdb
clang-tools-extra
